title: LADM Land Registration Module Shared Datatypes
description: Common data types aligned with OGC API Records, ISO 19157, and ISO 19107.

CodeListRef.description: Reference to an external codelist concept using the OGC API Records 'theme' pattern. The 'scheme' identifies the codelist vocabulary; 'concepts' lists the selected concept(s).

id.description: Code / local identifier within the scheme

scheme.description: URI of the codelist / vocabulary (e.g. an INSPIRE codelist, SKOS ConceptScheme, or QUDT unit registry)

LA_AvailabilityStatusType.description: LA_AvailabilityStatusType — availability status of the source document

Contact.description: Party contact information, aligned with OGC API Records contact object. Used for LA_AdministrativeSource party associations and LA_Source responsible parties.

identifier.description: Identifier for the contact (e.g. ORC-iD, national ID)

name.description: Name of the person or organisation

roles.description: Roles this contact plays (e.g. 'conveyancer', 'owner', 'surveyor'). LADM-specific roles should reference a CodeListRef.

DQ_Quality.description: Data quality element per ISO 19157. The 'type' references the ISO 19157 quality measure registry via CodeListRef.

type.description: ISO 19157 quality element type. Reference the ISO 19157 quality measure registry (https://def.isotc211.org/iso19157/-2/2023/QualityMeasure/). Common values: DQ_AbsoluteExternalPositionalAccuracy, DQ_CompletenessCommission, DQ_TopologicalConsistency, etc.

unit.description: Unit of measure for the result value

lineage.description: LI_Lineage — textual description of the origin of the data

Fraction.description: A rational number expressed as a numerator/denominator pair. Used for co-ownership shares in LA_RRR.

ExtPartyIdentifier.description: External identifier for a party (e.g. national ID number, company registration number, ORC-iD). The 'type' CodeListRef identifies the identifier scheme.

type.description: The identifier scheme (e.g. 'OIB' for Croatian personal ID, 'ORC-iD', 'VAT')

FeatureRef.description: Typed reference to any LADM feature. Provides the target type before dereferencing. 'href' is present for existing (already registered) objects; absent for newly created objects that have no persistent API endpoint yet (e.g. in a submission package). At minimum one of 'id' or 'href' must be provided.

featureType.description: LADM feature type of the referenced object (e.g. 'LA_SpatialUnit', 'LA_BAUnit', 'LA_Right')

id.description: Unique identifier of the referenced feature. For new objects in a submission, use a client-generated UUID. For existing objects, use the cadastre-assigned UUID or URI.

href.description: Dereferenceable URI of the referenced feature (OGC API - Features item endpoint). Present for existing objects; omitted for new objects not yet registered.

title.description: Human-readable label for the referenced feature

RRRRef.description: A reference to any LA_RRR subtype (right, restriction, responsibility). Either a URI link or an embedded object identified by the 'rrrType' discriminator.

SourceRef.description: A reference to any LADM Source. Either a URI (external link) or a full embedded LA_SpatialSource or LA_AdministrativeSource object, identified by the 'sourceType' discriminator.
